examples.original: No temas, hijo. Solo fue una pesadilla.
examples.translated: Don't be afraid, son. It was just a nightmare.

examples.translated: I'm afraid you can't come in.

examples.original: Me temo que tiene razón sobre el resultado del partido.

examples.translated: Does Santiago hold a grudge against us because we didn't invite him?

examples.translated: Luisa bears ill will toward me since I stole her position.
